chunks: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And if you intermingle with them, so they are your brethren'

He said: It means the orphans. When a man has custody of orphans in his care, let him spend from his own wealth in proportion to what he spends for each of them, so he mixes with them and they all eat together.
And he should not take anything (extra) from their wealth. Rather, it is the Fire.
ai.seo_question: How should a guardian manage and spend from an orphan's wealth according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the phrase 'if you mix with them' (wa in tukhalituhum) in Surah Al-Baqarah as referring specifically to orphans under one's guardianship. The ruling emphasizes that a custodian must spend from their own pocket in proportion to what they spend from the orphans' wealth, ensuring they eat together to demonstrate genuine care rather than mere administration. This practice of 'mixing' serves as a safeguard against exploitation, reinforcing the warning that unjustly consuming orphan wealth leads to the Fire.

en.hubeali: ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:220] and if you intermingle with them, so they are your brethren.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means the orphans, when the man (custodian) governs the orphans in his lap (care), so let him take from his own wealth upon a measurement of what he takes for each person from them. So he mixes them and they are all eating,
and he should not take anything (extra) from their wealth. But rather, it is the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 2. ‘Uthman has narrated from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “
About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘If you mix with them then they are your brothers in religion’,

abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is a reference to orphans. If one becomes the person-in-charge of the affairs of orphans, one must take from one’s own assets a certain amount, and equal to this amount from every one of the orphan assets take the same amount; then mix them for the use of all of them together.
One must not use anything from their property; it is the fire.’”
